english.title: Fail to remove animal from Parliament Square Garden
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being in charge of an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), within the central garden of Parliament Square, failed to remove that animal after being required to do so by an authorised person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 3(1)(e) of the Parliament Square Garden Byelaws 2012 and section 385(3) of the Greater London Authority Act 1999.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) See byelaw 3(2) for an exemption to byelaw 3(1) for an authorised person, member of the armed forces or any fire brigade or ambulance service in the performance of duties.(ii) See byelaw 9 where a person must, on demand, provide their name and address should an authorised person have reasonable ground to believe a person has contravened the byelaws.
